description: tether-sonnet and tether-onboard-sonnet are the two treatment configs; they must pin the identical model and Claude Code version (claude-sonnet-4-6 / 2.1.167, in startup_args and settings_json) and differ ONLY by tether-onboard-sonnet's onboard=true flag, which gates the headless tether-onboard pass. A pin changed in one but not the other breaks comparability between the onboarded and non-onboarded treatment arms.
